report_name: D2N2 Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan
how_pct_was_used: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) was used to develop a bespoke demand assessment for the D2N2 area by analyzing 2011 Census Journey to Work data to identify short trips and potential for modal shift, which helped validate existing network plans and inform prioritisation.
other_tools_developed: A bespoke demand assessment for D2N2 using open source data from the PCT, and a prioritisation exercise using core indicators (Congestion, Health Deprivation, Economic Growth, Tourism, Air quality/CO2 emissions, and Mode shift potential) to categorize schemes into short, medium, or long-term delivery.
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP process informed the successful Transforming Cities Fund bid, supported applications for the Emergency Active Travel Fund (EATF), and helped secure £18m for active travel infrastructure from the Local Growth Fund in 2015.
pct_usage_quote: The 2011 Census Journey to Work Data forms the basis of the Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT). The GIS team used the open source data from the PCT to develop a bespoke demand assessment for D2N2.
